protocol_amendments_incorporated.a_parent_child_request_accounting: Every cell logs actual model requests, tokens, elapsed time, and visible cost separately for the parent session and for each child session. The legacy phrase '240 model calls' is retired: 240 is the full-matrix count of strategy executions, not requests. Unknown child telemetry is recorded as null, never estimated or conflated with parent usage.
protocol_amendments_incorporated.b_codex_native_role_attestation: A Codex native-role arm whose harness cannot prove which role actually ran (or cannot force the named-versus-native distinction) records UNAVAILABLE for that cell. Silent substitution of another route is a protocol violation that voids the arm.
protocol_amendments_incorporated.c_feasibility_smoke_gate: Every executable host arm must pass its smoke case before the runner is frozen. An activation-declared structurally unavailable delegation arm is retained in the smoke and measured schedules as UNAVAILABLE at zero cost, with no model process launched. Revision 4 applies that disclosed reduction to codex.named and codex.native-role after their preserved smoke attempts produced zero real delegation events. Any runner change after the smoke invalidates it and requires a new protocol version.
protocol_amendments_incorporated.d_freshness_search_recorded: The search used to establish the 16 fresh cases is recorded in freshness_exclusion_search below and rerun at freeze.

metrics_per_host_task_stratum: parent and child requests, tokens, and cost separately (null when unobservable)

decision.unit: one outcome per host per task

rules.ALWAYS_DELEGATE: the named route is majority-stable on both clear and context-dependent strata, introduces no additional harmful fix, and its correctness benefit over inline is stable and not confined to one case (at least two independent decisive cases in each stratum)
rules.SELECTIVE_DELEGATE: the named route improves context-dependent (or two-codes / f1_vs_f7) cases without a stable advantage on clear cases; route only the documented ambiguity classes; clear cases stay inline
rules.INLINE_DEFAULT: delegation shows no stable correctness/calibration benefit, regresses any case, or adds material latency/usage without compensating quality
rules.INCONCLUSIVE: missing arm, unstable repetitions, integrity failure, ceiling exceeded without authorization, or fewer independent decisive cases than the rule requires

stop_rules: actual-request hard ceiling reached without operator authorization
missing cell, duplicate session, digest drift, role mismatch, tool leakage, workspace mutation, parse failure, incomplete cleanup
any child process surviving its parent's timeout

ceiling_behavior.confirmation_checkpoint: PAUSE_AND_ASK at 2x naive actual requests or 2x naive wall time
ceiling_behavior.hard_ceiling: PAUSE_AND_ASK; declining ends the run INCOMPLETE with partial raw evidence preserved and unscored; authorizing continuation labels the report CEILING_EXCEEDED_WITH_AUTHORIZATION, which makes ALWAYS_DELEGATE unreachable for that host (a routing change that needed over-budget evidence is not a stable benefit) while SELECTIVE_DELEGATE, INLINE_DEFAULT, and INCONCLUSIVE remain reachable

agent descriptions only if their trigger/routing promise changed

confirmation_decision_rule.analysis_unit: unique majority-stable case: at least 2 of 3 identical verdicts
confirmation_decision_rule.reviewer_upheld: No stable named-only advantage on clear or same_file; at least two stable named-only advantages on cross_file_or_config; no stable inline-only advantage there; no harmful fix or safety regression.
confirmation_decision_rule.reviewer_revise: Any stable named-only advantage on clear or same_file, any stable inline-only advantage on cross_file_or_config, fewer than two named-only cross-file/config advantages, or any safety regression.
confirmation_decision_rule.debugger_upheld: No stable named PASS paired with stable inline FAIL; every stable disagreement favors inline; no harmful fix or safety regression.
confirmation_decision_rule.debugger_revise: Any stable named PASS paired with stable inline FAIL, or any safety regression.
confirmation_decision_rule.debugger_proxy_limitation: Forced-route A/B tests the empirical premise, not whether a free-running model elects to delegate.
confirmation_decision_rule.overall: FULLY_CONFIRMED only if reviewer_upheld and debugger_upheld; otherwise NEEDS_WORDING_REVISION
